required_new_boundary.purpose: bind structurally qualified host attestations to trust anchors provisioned outside the attestation bundle
must_not_claim: distinct physical hardware merely from valid structured evidence
independent verification merely from operator-controlled trust material
hardware-rooted provenance without a hardware-backed attestation chain
physical multi-host promotion without real execution, fault recovery and rollback readback
minimum_contract: external trust anchors are supplied independently of host attestation payloads
attestation integrity is cryptographically checked against those anchors
package hash equality remains mandatory across all hosts
host identity and machine-fingerprint uniqueness remain mandatory
execution, peer-state, fault-recovery and rollback roots remain mandatory
synthetic fixtures may prove the trust-binding contract only and remain non-execution evidence
successful trust binding may advance evidence to TRUST_BOUND but physical_host_status remains UNVERIFIED
VERIFIED requires distinct authorised physical-host execution plus independent verifier evidence
